# Real RTX1210 `/system/config0` shape: tunnel 1 has IKE lines INSIDE the
# `tunnel select 1` block (indented), tunnel 2 has IKE lines at column 0
# (outside any tunnel block). Both must parse correctly. Mirrors the layout
# encountered in the home-monitor home network at the time fix/tunnel-parser-col0-ike-lines
# was opened.

tunnel select 1
 tunnel encapsulation l2tpv3
 tunnel endpoint name itm.ohno.be fqdn
 ipsec tunnel 101
  ipsec sa policy 101 1 esp aes-cbc sha-hmac
  ipsec ike keepalive log 1 off
  ipsec ike keepalive use 1 on heartbeat 10 6
  ipsec ike local address 1 192.168.1.253
  ipsec ike log 1 key-info message-info payload-info
  ipsec ike nat-traversal 1 on
  ipsec ike pre-shared-key 1 text 893kick!
  ipsec ike remote address 1 119.231.58.172
  ipsec ike remote name 1 l2tpv3 key-id
 l2tp always-on on
 l2tp tunnel disconnect time off
 tunnel enable 1
tunnel select 2
 tunnel encapsulation l2tp
 ipsec tunnel 1
  ipsec sa policy 1 1 esp aes-cbc sha-hmac
 l2tp tunnel disconnect time off
 tunnel enable 2
# Unrelated col-0 line between tunnel blocks and the IKE config:
no tunnel enable all
ipsec ike encryption 2 aes-cbc
ipsec ike group 2 modp2048
ipsec ike hash 2 sha256
ipsec ike keepalive use 2 on dpd 10 6
ipsec ike nat-traversal 2 on
ipsec ike pre-shared-key 2 text 893kick!
ipsec ike remote address 2 any
